scope: Asynchronous server-side visible-registry coordination and safe single-generation provider withdrawal; no live frontend certification

contract.initiallyDisabled: No management/control/claim globals; one internal same-display observer client
publication: sync and verify own visible pair
contract.io: Private socketpair; existing server event loop; public client/server APIs; no roundtrip, listener socket, thread, process or global-filter replacement; WRITABLE only for EAGAIN
contract.generationPolicy: After creating a claim, retirement/failure is terminal for this module lifetime; future login, never hot unload/load
contract.withdrawal: Cancel queue, availability=false, inert control resources, wl_global_remove; retain one core/globals/managers/desktops/offers until teardown
contract.lateBinds: Already-offered pre-removal binds remain valid, unavailable and cannot activate
contract.launcher: Requires serverArbitrationVersion=1, arbitrationState=active and providerRestartRequired exactly false, plus existing barrier v2 checks; read-only preflight
contract.invalidBackend: Reject and withdraw; no empty-snapshot fallback and no subsequent availability=true
